existing_source_updates.input_table_audit: Inspected downloaded supporting PDF: Table S7, PDF p34, provides basic parameters before/after balancing (B, P/B, Q/B, EE and migration); Table S8 p35 contains numeric prey-by-predator diet fractions; Table S9 p36 includes fleet extraction. E.g. herring B=0.3583 gC/m2, P/B=0.860, Q/B=4.500; diet table distinguishes pre/post balancing. Manual extraction and Ecopath loading have not been performed.

Inspected downloaded supporting DOCX: Table B4 (fifth DOCX table,55 rows) has B/PB/QB/EE and other basic parameters; Table B2 (second and third DOCX tables,56 rows each) contains numeric 1985 diet matrix across predators1-50, including whiting/haddock/pouts rows. Table B3 contains landings/discards. These are actual numeric reconstruction inputs; no model-load test.

Inspected main PDF Table1 p4 with landings, initial biomass, PB/QB/PQ for29 groups; Table B.1 p12 contains numeric diet matrix with27 consumer columns. Example Harpadon nehereus B=0.387, PB=4.560, QB=15.255. Both input and diet tables are present; no extraction/load test.

Inspected downloaded S2 PDF: Tables D/F on PDFpp4/6 are basic B/PB/QB/EE parameters for with/without-discard models; Tables E/G on pp5/7 are numeric diet matrices including imports and column sums. Example MB1 pelagic fish B=0.43, PB=0.4, QB=1.4. Main and both supplements retrieved; no model-load test.

Inspected main PDF Appendix Table I p14 (printed91): B,PB,QB,EE andPQ for balanced late1990s northernBenguela model. Appendix Table II p15 (printed92) contains numeric diet proportions. Basic inputs distinguished in bold; numeric microzooplankton PB=482,QB=1928. Appendix describes186500km2 model shelf20-600m fromOrangeRiver to15S. No reconstruction/load test.

Inspected supporting PDF Table S2 pp5-7 with numeric B,PB,QB,EE for103 groups spanning fourMediterranean regions. Visually inspected rendered Table S3 p8: numeric diet matrix with numbered prey/predators, imports and column sums. Matrix is embedded as an image, requiring careful transcription/OCR, not straightforward PDFtext extraction. No reconstruction/load test.

Inspected main PDF Table2 p7 (printed305): numeric B,PB,QB,EE plus landings for27groups, estimated outputs parenthesized. Table3 p8 (printed306) contains diet proportions forpredatorgroups3-26, explicitly describesmid1970s diets supporting1979baseline. Example benthicproducer B153,PB11.86; smallherbivorouszooplankton B2.43,PB60.22,QB220. No reconstruction/load test.
